proposition: Timurid courts show the ambiguity in practice: a Sunni queen endowing the shrine at Mashhad, a sultan trying to have the khuṭba said for the twelve Imams, and coins pairing ʿAlī walī Allāh with the first three caliphs.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
